name: nat_add_zero
statement: ∀ n : Nat, n + 0 = n

name: nat_zero_add
statement: ∀ n : Nat, 0 + n = n

name: nat_add_assoc
statement: ∀ a b c : Nat, a + b + c = a + (b + c)

name: nat_mul_one
statement: ∀ n : Nat, n * 1 = n

name: nat_le_add_right
statement: ∀ a b : Nat, a ≤ a + b

name: nat_two_mul
statement: ∀ n : Nat, 2 * n = n + n

name: nat_sub_self
statement: ∀ n : Nat, n - n = 0

name: nat_succ_le_of_lt
statement: ∀ a b : Nat, a < b → a + 1 ≤ b

name: nat_mod_three_lt
statement: ∀ n : Nat, n % 3 < 3

name: list_append_nil
statement: ∀ l : List Nat, l ++ [] = l

name: list_nil_append
statement: ∀ l : List Nat, [] ++ l = l

name: list_length_cons
statement: ∀ (x : Nat) (l : List Nat), (x :: l).length = l.length + 1

name: list_map_id
statement: ∀ l : List Nat, l.map id = l

name: list_append_assoc
statement: ∀ l₁ l₂ l₃ : List Nat, l₁ ++ l₂ ++ l₃ = l₁ ++ (l₂ ++ l₃)

name: list_length_reverse
statement: ∀ l : List Nat, l.reverse.length = l.length

name: list_length_map
statement: ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (l : List Nat), (l.map f).length = l.length

name: list_length_append_self
statement: ∀ l : List Nat, (l ++ l).length = 2 * l.length

name: prop_and_comm
statement: ∀ p q : Prop, p ∧ q → q ∧ p

name: prop_id
statement: ∀ p : Prop, p → p

name: prop_const
statement: ∀ p q : Prop, p → q → p

name: prop_imp_trans
statement: ∀ p q r : Prop, (p → q) → (q → r) → p → r

name: prop_or_false
statement: ∀ p : Prop, p ∨ False → p

name: prop_and_intro
statement: ∀ p q : Prop, p → q → p ∧ q

name: rec_triple
statement: ∀ n : Nat, triple n = 3 * n
prelude: @[simp] def triple : Nat → Nat | 0 => 0 | n+1 => triple n + 3

name: rec_len
statement: ∀ l : List Nat, len l = l.length
prelude: @[simp] def len : List Nat → Nat | [] => 0 | _ :: xs => len xs + 1

name: rec_sum_list_append
statement: ∀ l₁ l₂ : List Nat, sumList (l₁ ++ l₂) = sumList l₁ + sumList l₂
prelude: @[simp] def sumList : List Nat → Nat | [] => 0 | x :: xs => x + sumList xs

name: rec_countdown_length
statement: ∀ n : Nat, (countdown n).length = n
prelude: @[simp] def countdown : Nat → List Nat | 0 => [] | n+1 => n :: countdown n

name: rec_add2
statement: ∀ n m : Nat, add2 n m = n + m
prelude: @[simp] def add2 : Nat → Nat → Nat | 0, m => m | n+1, m => add2 n m + 1

name: rec_pow2_pos
statement: ∀ n : Nat, 0 < pow2 n
prelude: @[simp] def pow2 : Nat → Nat | 0 => 1 | n+1 => 2 * pow2 n

name: hard_mul_comm
statement: ∀ a b : Nat, a * b = b * a

name: hard_map_comp
statement: ∀ (f g : Nat → Nat) (l : List Nat), (l.map f).map g = l.map (fun x => g (f x))

name: hard_dvd_mul_left
statement: ∀ a b c : Nat, a ∣ b → a ∣ c * b

name: hard_mul_le_mul
statement: ∀ a b c d : Nat, a ≤ b → c ≤ d → a * c ≤ b * d

name: hard_mul_add
statement: ∀ a b c : Nat, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c

name: hard_map_reverse
statement: ∀ (l : List Nat) (f : Nat → Nat), (l.map f).reverse = l.reverse.map f

name: hard_add_sq
statement: ∀ a b : Nat, (a + b) * (a + b) = a * a + 2 * a * b + b * b

name: hard_map_succ_sum
statement: ∀ l : List Nat, (l.map (· + 1)).sum = l.sum + l.length

name: hard_sum_double
statement: ∀ n : Nat, sumDouble n = n * (n + 1)
prelude: @[simp] def sumDouble : Nat → Nat | 0 => 0 | n+1 => sumDouble n + 2 * (n + 1)

name: hard_pow_le_pow
statement: ∀ a b : Nat, a ≤ b → 2 ^ a ≤ 2 ^ b
